mission: Mission 3CW - PopSign fresh5 architecture/data generalization failure packet

scope.purpose: Classify the strongest current non-training explanation for the completed M3CR PopSign fresh5 collapse using existing receipts, diagnostics, and read-only code inspection.

evidence_matrix.evidence: The scratch_region_temporal_late_fusion_tcn_contract_v1 path train-fit one deterministic balanced clip per label.
evidence_matrix.failure_explanation_ruled_out_or_reduced: Total loader, label-index, gradient-flow, optimizer-step, or architecture-connectivity break.

evidence_matrix.evidence: Repaired manifests are balanced and tensor-complete with no cross-split overlap.
evidence_matrix.failure_explanation_ruled_out_or_reduced: Label-count imbalance, tensor coverage failure, duplicate tensor/hash leakage, or cross-split leakage.

evidence_matrix.evidence: Split/source/signer/tensor gates passed for the approved single-source PopSign lane.
evidence_matrix.failure_explanation_ruled_out_or_reduced: Obvious split/source/signer contract failure explaining the collapse.

evidence_matrix.evidence: Mechanical source-label ambiguity cleared for all five labels, including thank_you to source slug thankyou.
evidence_matrix.failure_explanation_ruled_out_or_reduced: Mechanical source slug or label mapping ambiguity in the repaired manifests.

evidence_matrix.evidence: All 375 repaired tensors loaded and matched manifest hashes with consistent shape, dtype, and region order.
evidence_matrix.failure_explanation_ruled_out_or_reduced: Visible tensor corruption, crop/region-order defect, finite-value failure, or low-signal pen/thank_you outlier.

evidence_matrix.evidence: Sampler and exposure review found balanced full-split coverage and consistent class mapping.
evidence_matrix.failure_explanation_ruled_out_or_reduced: Class-index mismatch, batch-cap underexposure, evaluator-support issue, or pen over/underexposure.

evidence_matrix.evidence: Optimizer/loss/regularization wiring review found no visible wiring defect.
evidence_matrix.failure_explanation_ruled_out_or_reduced: Loss/target dtype wiring, class weights, scheduler, active dropout/BatchNorm state, augmentation, or threshold-calibration root cause.

evidence_matrix.evidence: Bounded local 20-epoch LR 0.003 train-all completed and failed to improve over M3CJ.
evidence_matrix.failure_explanation_ruled_out_or_reduced: The collapse is not fixed by the bounded post-contract optimizer schedule.

evidence_matrix.evidence: Result diagnosis found near-uniform low-confidence behavior and threshold behavior downstream of collapse.
evidence_matrix.failure_explanation_ruled_out_or_reduced: Artifact, command, checkpoint-selection, threshold-calibration, export, or browser-promotion root cause.

evidence_matrix.evidence: Train, validation, and test logits all collapse to the same tiny class-order offset.
evidence_matrix.failure_explanation_ruled_out_or_reduced: Held-out-only generalization issue, threshold-only issue, reporting-only issue, or classifier-bias-only explanation.

evidence_matrix.evidence: Train-split features are nonseparable before the classifier head at linear_input_post_layernorm.
evidence_matrix.failure_explanation_ruled_out_or_reduced: Last-layer-only or readout-bias-only root cause as the next best explanation.

evidence_matrix.evidence: Collapse is already visible at fused head input before LayerNorm/readout.
evidence_matrix.failure_explanation_ruled_out_or_reduced: LayerNorm/readout boundary as the sole source of collapse.

read_only_code_contract_summary.train_code_observation: The model expects B,T,R,C,H,W, normalizes each clip, encodes each frame-region with a shared scratch 2D encoder, applies per-region temporal blocks, fuses region features with learned region attention, and uses LayerNorm plus a linear head.
read_only_code_contract_summary.input_contract_observation: The PopSign fresh5 training-smoke mode preserves rgb_regions as T,R,H,W,C, prepares T,R,C,H,W, and batches B,T,R,C,H,W.
read_only_code_contract_summary.loss_optimizer_observation: The reviewed training path uses CrossEntropyLoss over scalar class targets and AdamW when selected.
read_only_code_contract_summary.evaluation_contract_observation: PopSign fresh5 training-smoke evaluation requires five repaired labels and preserve_region_axis=true, and records that the smoke is capped and not final 75-100-label or lesson evidence.

failure_explanations_ruled_out.basis: M3CK train-fit reached 1.0 accuracy on 5/5 balanced deterministic clips with nonzero gradient and parameter movement.
M3CL/M3CM record 25 clips per label per split, full tensor hash coverage, and zero cross-split clip/source-record/signer/tensor overlap.
M3CN cleared source slugs for all five labels, including thank_you to thankyou.

failure_explanations_ruled_out.explanation: visible tensor corruption or region-order failure
failure_explanations_ruled_out.basis: M3CO scanned all 375 repaired tensors and found consistent 16x5x96x96x3 uint8 T,R,H,W,C evidence with no finite or low-signal failures.

failure_explanations_ruled_out.explanation: sampler, class mapping, batch cap, or evaluator-support defect
failure_explanations_ruled_out.basis: M3CP found full 125-example coverage per split, consistent sorted mapping, shuffle/drop_last behavior, and 32 batches per split.

failure_explanations_ruled_out.explanation: loss/target/optimizer/regularization wiring defect visible in code receipts
failure_explanations_ruled_out.basis: M3CQ found no visible CrossEntropyLoss target, AdamW, scheduler, class-weight, dropout, BatchNorm, augmentation, or threshold root cause.
M3CT found the train split collapses with the same top-1/top-2 pattern as validation/test.
M3CU and M3CV localized nonseparable representation before the classifier head and before the LayerNorm/readout boundary.

failure_explanations_still_plausible.explanation: scratch architecture capacity or inductive-bias mismatch
failure_explanations_still_plausible.basis: The architecture can memorize one deterministic example per label but fails to form label-separating representations across the full balanced 125-clip train split.

failure_explanations_still_plausible.explanation: optimization/generalization limit of the current local recipe
failure_explanations_still_plausible.basis: A 20-epoch LR 0.003 bounded diagnostic still produced near-uniform collapsed logits and collapsed train representations, while M3CQ found no simple optimizer/loss wiring bug.

failure_explanations_still_plausible.explanation: input representation or crop target is insufficient for this architecture
failure_explanations_still_plausible.basis: Tensors are mechanically valid and region axis is preserved, but no current evidence proves the selected five-region 16-frame crop representation contains enough discriminative signal for this scratch model.

failure_explanations_still_plausible.explanation: dataset size/diversity or single-source data limitation
failure_explanations_still_plausible.basis: The dataset is balanced and source-approved, but 25 clips per label per split from one source may still be too small or too distribution-limited for the current scratch lane.

failure_explanations_still_plausible.explanation: label/source semantic quality beyond mechanical source slug review
failure_explanations_still_plausible.basis: M3CN did not claim external ASL educator correctness or regional-variant review, but the uniform full-train representation collapse across all labels is not explained by a single mechanical label issue.

strongest_current_explanation.summary: The strongest current explanation is that the current from-scratch scratch_region_temporal_late_fusion_tcn_contract_v1 lane, with the tested optimizer schedule and repaired PopSign fresh5 data envelope, is not learning label-separating representations beyond a tiny deterministic microprobe. The evidence does not prove a single data-quality, tensor, sampler, loss, last-layer, or LayerNorm bug, and it does not authorize a blind training, Brev, architecture, input, source, tensor, export, or claim change.
confidence_limits: No new training, fitted classifier, architecture prototype, or input ablation was run in this packet.
Existing evidence can rank explanations but cannot isolate architecture capacity from input-representation or dataset-diversity limits without a current strategy review or future approved experiment.

strategy_memo_coverage.gap: The prior strategy/design artifacts predate the M3CR 20-epoch failed local train-all, M3CT stable train/validation/test logit collapse, M3CU nonseparable train feature diagnostic, and M3CV localization of collapse before LayerNorm/readout. They also selected or informed the current scratch region-temporal late-fusion TCN contract that has now failed to form train-split separable representations.

decision.next_action_rationale: The strongest current explanation points toward architecture/optimization/input/data strategy, but the existing strategy memo is not current for the M3CR-M3CV representation-collapse evidence. The next meaningful action would change or reassess architecture, input representation, training strategy, budget, or compute route, so the bounded executor action is strategy escalation with this local evidence rather than another no-training local packet or any fitting/Brev/export/promotion change.
